name: desk-mic
description: Talk to Claude from your computer's microphone: /mic puts what you say in the prompt box (or sends it), and can speak replies back.

engine.title: Speech engine
engine.description: deepgram (cloud, needs an API key) or whisper (runs on this computer)

deepgramApiKey.title: Deepgram API key
deepgramApiKey.description: Only needed for the deepgram engine

whisperModel.title: Whisper model
whisperModel.description: Model size for the whisper engine

vadLevel.title: Whisper voice-detection level
vadLevel.description: 0 to 3; higher ignores more background noise

sendMode.title: How a sentence is sent
sendMode.description: word: build the prompt until you say a send word. pause: send each sentence when you pause.

sendWords.title: Send words
sendWords.description: Comma-separated words that send the prompt

stopWords.title: Stop words
stopWords.description: Said alone, these end Claude's running reply (comma list)
stopWords.default: stop, cancel, wait, hold on, never mind

useWakeWord.title: Use a wake word
useWakeWord.description: Only act on speech that starts with the wake word

pauseSeconds.title: Pause length (seconds)
pauseSeconds.description: Quiet time that ends a sentence (minimum 1; deepgram accepts 1 to 5)

speakBack.title: Speak replies back
speakBack.description: Read Claude's replies aloud while the mic is on

interruptReading.title: Interrupt reading aloud
interruptReading.description: Keep listening while a reply is read aloud, so a stop word or a sentence starting with the wake word cuts it off. Turn off if loud speakers make it cut itself off

muteKey.title: Mute key
muteKey.description: auto = Right Ctrl on Windows, Right Option on Mac
